title: csvtoxml action
description: Converts a CSV body to XML: <rows><row><field>…</field>…</row>…</rows>.

useHeader.title: Use header
useHeader.description: The first record names the fields; otherwise they are field1, field2, ...

useHeaders.title: Use headers
useHeaders.description: Same as useHeader (the newer name); either one turns it on

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Encoding named in the XML declaration; the body itself stays text (use the encoder step to convert it)
